types.description: Conversation, project instructions, attachments and other context visibly available in the current runtime.
A file explicitly attached by the user to the current interaction.
A specific local file explicitly supplied or approved by the user.
An approved local directory whose relevant supported files may be inventoried before selective reading.
A structured knowledge directory such as an Obsidian vault or equivalent workspace.
A local or user-supplied repository containing relevant public identity, methods, content or instructions.
Any existing personal, professional, brand, creator or AI collaboration profile.
CV, biography, portfolio, brand guide, strategy document, case study or related first-party material.
Posts, scripts, newsletters, articles, transcripts or other creator-authored material.
A website or page explicitly supplied by the user.
A public social profile explicitly supplied by the user.
An existing content or knowledge system used only as an optional evidence source.
A statement supplied directly by the user during onboarding or correction.
A generated scenario or content sample evaluated by the user during calibration.
